The other lead equity managers are Simon Clements (who was formerly head of global equities at Aviva Investors) along with Chris Foster, who joined the management training programme at ATI as a graduate.
Simon Clements is a fund manager who joined Liontrust in 2017 as part of the acquisition of Alliance Trust Investments, where he had managed funds for five years.
